callees.name: _normalize_backend
callees.pre_condition: backend is a string representing a configured backend name.
callees.post_condition: Returns the canonical backend name corresponding to the input string. Every recognized alias for a given backend resolves to the same canonical name. The returned string is always one of the canonical backend name strings. If the input is already a canonical name, it is returned unchanged. If the input matches no recognized alias, it is returned unchanged.
